first.rationale: I currently intend to test a focused onboarding simplification because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shorter onboarding and fewer signup fields can improve early adoption. I will verify the two most directly relevant records before committing, while guarding against higher completion without improved qualified revenue. Aggressive pricing may address competitor pressure but risks margin and durable revenue quality.

final.rationale: Run a focused onboarding simplification test for self-serve SMB accounts, combining shorter onboarding with fewer signup fields. This directly addresses the 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline, with confirmed gains in completion, time-to-value, activation, retention, and qualified revenue. Keep the test guarded with segment targeting and holdout monitoring because signup simplification showed a 1% 30-day retention decline and has not been validated beyond SMB. Evaluate qualified revenue and retention, not completion alone, before rollout.
